header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH CIRCUIT COURT MIRPUR KHAS
Petitioner: :Through Mr. Mir Muhammad Nohri, Advocate
body: 1. Respondents No 2 & 3 file comments taken on record.

2. Through instant Petition, the petitioner seeks appointment in Departments of Government of Sindh under the 5% quota reserved for the Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) under the provisions of Sindh Empowerment of Persons With Disabilities Act, 2018 (SEPDA). It is the case of the Petitioner that he applied for the post in BS 01 to 04 and duly recommended by the District Recruitment Committee but appointment letter has not been issued to him. Learned Counsel prays to direct the Respondents to issue him appointment order under the quota reserved for disable 3. Learned Assistant Advocate General, after perusal of reply filed by the Respondent No 2 & 3 contended that Petitioner’s case for appointment has been recommended by DRC to concerned department for issuance of appointment letters. He prays for disposal of the petition.

4. In view of above this Petition is disposed of with directions to the Respondents to expedite the recruitment process and finalize the same within one month’s time and ensure that the grievance of the Petitioner is redressed within 30 days from date of this order.
5. Office is directed to send the copy of this order to Respondents for compliance.
